letter.role_title: Working Student (f/m/d) – Supply Chain Management Optimization and Data Science
letter.opening: I am applying for the Working Student position in Supply Chain Management Optimization and Data Science. Combining optimization and machine learning to plan real supply chains, inside SAP's own products, connects my SAP background with my M.Sc. in Data Science and my Sequential Decision Making course.
letter.profile_intro: I am an M.Sc. Data Science student at TU Ilmenau with a B.S. in Artificial Intelligence, where I built computer vision and NLP projects in PyTorch. I also bring industry experience in SQL, data pipelines and dashboards from SAP data & analytics work.

achievements.impact: in my thesis team I evaluated and tuned an EfficientNet-B0 model and compared EasyOCR configurations
I built a PyTorch retinal OCT classifier on EfficientNet-B0 reaching 94.11% accuracy on a 968-image test set
at Tapal Tea I analysed purchasing data from SAP reports and supported dashboards for supply chain and procurement

letter.problems_section: I would contribute Python, experience creating and evaluating ML models, and practical knowledge of supply chain and procurement data from SAP. I have not used C++ professionally, but I am willing to learn it, as the posting allows.
letter.closing: I am available immediately for up to 20 hours per week and am happy to relocate to Munich. I would be glad to discuss how I can contribute.
letter.language_closing: I work in English (IELTS 8.0) and am currently learning German (A1).
